title: Ganoderterpene A, a New Triterpenoid from Ganoderma lucidum, Attenuates LPS-Induced Inflammation and Apoptosis via Suppressing MAPK and TLR-4/NF-kappaB Pathways in BV-2 Cells.
authors: Kou, Rong-Wei; Gao, Yu-Qi; Xia, Bing; Wang, Jia-Yun; Liu, Xiao-Ning; Tang, Jiang-Jiang; Yin, Xia; Gao, Jin-Ming
journal: Journal of agricultural and food chemistry
one_liner_zh: 该文研究灵芝三萜化合物抗炎抗凋亡作用，涉及MAPK/TLR-4/NF-kB通路，与蛋白质-DNA互作及TF-DNA结合建模完全无关。
abstract: An investigation of the fruiting bodies of edible mushroom Ganoderma lucidum produced 13 steroids, containing one new lanostane-type triterpene compound, named ganoderterpene A (1). Nuclear magnetic resonance and high-resolution electrospray ionization mass spectrometry data were used to deduce these structures. All the isolates were evaluated for their ability to suppress NO generation in BV-2 microglial cells treated with lipopolysaccharide (LPS) and exhibited moderate to strong inhibition effects, with IC(50) values in the range 7.15-36.88 muM. Among the tested compounds, compound 1 exhibited the most marked activity with an IC(50) value of 7.15 muM, and the structure-activity relationships were studied. This study showed that compound 1 significantly suppressed the activation of MAPK and TLR-4/NF-kappaB signaling pathways, as evidenced by an immunofluorescence assay and a molecular docking experiment. Furthermore, compound 1 effectively improved the LPS-induced mitochondrial membrane potential and apoptosis. These findings suggest that ganoderterpene A could exert protective effects in microglial cells from apoptosis by restraining the inflammatory response. Hence, G. lucidum could be used as a novel preventative agent for neurodegenerative disorders.
abstract_zh: 对食用菌灵芝（Ganoderma lucidum）子实体的研究产生了13种类固醇化合物，其中包含一种新的羊毛甾烷型三萜化合物，命名为灵芝萜烯A（ganoderterpene A，1）。利用核磁共振和高分辨电喷雾电离质谱数据推断了这些结构。所有分离物均评估了其在脂多糖（LPS）处理的BV-2小胶质细胞中抑制NO生成的能力，并表现出中等至强烈的抑制效果，IC(50)值范围为7.15-36.88 μM。在测试的化合物中，化合物1表现出最显著的活性，IC(50)值为7.15 μM，并研究了构效关系。本研究表明，化合物1显著抑制了MAPK和TLR-4/NF-κB信号通路的激活，这一点通过免疫荧光实验和分子对接实验得到证实。此外，化合物1有效改善了LPS诱导的线粒体膜电位变化和细胞凋亡。这些发现表明，灵芝萜烯A可能通过抑制炎症反应，在小胶质细胞中发挥抗凋亡的保护作用。因此，灵芝（G. lucidum）可作为神经退行性疾病的新型预防剂。
